# Kubotics (KuroLIV GmbH)

> Swiss specialist in IT automation, business process automation, system integration, and industrial automation for SMEs.

## Core Services & Landing Pages

- [Home](https://www.kubotics.ch/): Overview of Kubotics automation and robotics capabilities.
- [IT & Business Process Automation](https://www.kubotics.ch/automation/it-business-process-automation): End-to-end workflow automation, ERP/CRM/M365 integration, legacy application modernization, and controlled AI workflows for Swiss SMEs (10–250 employees).
- [Invoice & Document Processing](https://www.kubotics.ch/automation/invoice-processing): Multimodal LLM-based invoice and document extraction with ERP integration.
- [Automation Discovery](https://www.kubotics.ch/automation/discovery): Structured process assessment and automation roadmap.
- [AI Marketing & Sales](https://www.kubotics.ch/marketing/ai-marketing-sales): AI-assisted lead generation and marketing automation.
- [CNC Machine Tending](https://www.kubotics.ch/automation/cnc-machine-tending): Industrial robotics and CNC machine tending.
- [Unitree H2 Test Day](https://www.kubotics.ch/robotics/unitree-h2-test-day): Humanoid robotics demonstration and testing.
